info.name: BigCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails System Logs API

params.name: limit
params.description: Query parameter that lets you return the number of results displayed per page.

params.name: page
params.description: Query parameter that lets you specify the starting page in which results are returned.

params.name: type
params.description: Query parameter that lets you filter the results by log type.

params.name: type:not
params.description: Query parameter that lets you exclude a log type from the results.

params.name: module
params.description: Query parameter that lets you filter the results by module.

params.name: module:not
params.description: Query parameter that lets you exclude a log module from the results.

params.name: severity
params.description: Query parameter that lets you filter results by severity level, as an integer. The following values are possible: Success = 1, Notice = 2, Warning = 3, Error = 4

params.name: severity:min
params.description: Query parameter that lets you filter by minimum severity, as an integer.

params.name: severity:max
params.description: Query parameter that lets you filter by maximum severity, as an integer.

params.name: id:in
params.description: Query parameter that lets you filter by a list of log IDs, as a CSV. For example ?id:in=3,4,6

params.name: date_created:min
params.description: Query parameter that lets you filter by the minimum date created in [Unix time](https://www.unixtimestamp.com/), for example, `?date_created:min=1657688400`. Returns logs created after this date.

params.name: date_created:max
params.description: Query parameter that lets you filter by the maximum date created in [Unix time](https://www.unixtimestamp.com/), for example, `?date_created:min=1658379600`. Returns logs created before this date.
